name: codedock-mail
description: Standalone mail control plane: maild API plus Postgres plus SnappyMail webmail. Point it at any IMAP/SMTP backend — a Stalwart engine, an existing mail server, or your company's — and manage domains, DKIM, DNS, and deliverability checks from one API.

configFields.label: maild API token
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Bearer token for every /api/* call. The dashboard and CLI present it; it never leaves the server.

configFields.label: Postgres password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Internal only — maild reaches Postgres over the compose network.

configFields.label: Engine admin secret
configFields.help: Paste the Stalwart fallback-admin (or admin account) secret. maild provisions domains and mailboxes through the engine management API with it.

settings.label: Mail backend
settings.description: Which IMAP/SMTP engine maild provisions on. Stalwart v0.15.x over its management API on port 8080. Leave the URL empty to run maild local-only (tracking and DNS without provisioning).

fields.label: Engine URL
fields.help: Base URL of the Stalwart management API, e.g. http://engine:8080. Blank → local-only mode.

connection.title: Sign in to Webmail
connection.description: Open the webmail URL and sign in with a full email address and its mailbox password. Create the domain and mailbox through the maild API first; the password is shown once at creation.

guide.intro: This stack holds no mail itself: maild tracks domains and metadata in Postgres, the engine stores the mail, and SnappyMail reads it live over IMAP.
guide.useHint: Add the domain's IMAP/SMTP entries in SnappyMail (/?admin, Domains tab) pointing at your engine host, then sign in with a mailbox created through maild.

outputs.label: Webmail
outputs.help: Sign in with an email address on your mail server and its mailbox password.
